title: 第578章 暂难离去第577章 恶劣之人
content_zh:
泽瑞尔实在是无法忍受高精灵神职们对满地阵亡士兵的高傲，那些混蛋们挤在一起取暖，抱怨着城防卫队士兵们动作缓慢，嘟囔着这趟行程危险又寒冷，就是不尽快进行祈祷仪式。
这对于同样身为神职的泽瑞尔来说，是傲慢无礼且极其亵渎死者的，艾什劝过他，不要帮助高精灵，泽瑞尔会因此更加伤心，可满心怜悯与仁慈的他，还是谢过了艾什的提醒，主动去找伊妮丝。
他还是想要为死去的士兵们而祈祷，他走了过去，他和伊妮丝交谈，没聊几句，泽瑞尔便垂头丧气的往回走，都不需要多想，艾什就能猜到伊妮丝和泽瑞尔说了些什么，
看着泽瑞尔走回叉腰叹气，艾什感到好笑地咧嘴把玩头发，高低挑眉一副早就知道会这样的表情。
“她是不是说你不是精灵，不需要你为高精灵士兵祈祷？”
“是的......”
“她是不是还说，感谢你的好意，但是有其他神职在，你也不懂他们的传统和习俗？”
“没错......”
“最后呢~又和你说，我们的委托已经结束，现在我们几个可以走了？”
“唉......”
这一声叹息就已能证明艾什的猜想都对了，她怪腔怪调地讪笑，拍打身上和星星铁裙甲上的雪花，对不远处的烤栗子吹了声口哨，烤栗子不急不慢地埋着蹄子跑来，用鼻子去贴艾什的脸。
艾什揉搓烤栗子的马头，偏过脸向沮丧又不理解伊妮丝想法的泽瑞尔弹舌，待对方满面哀愁地抬起头时，她翻身上马踩稳马镫嗤笑。
“我已经不信任这些高精灵了，神父，走吧，我们回去，他们的烂事，让他们自己去想办法，既然他们不接受你这样优秀的神父好意，那是他们愚蠢，我们现在回去还能吃上晚餐。”
“嗯......我还是觉得我没有你说的那么......优秀，不过，你说得对，艾什，我想休息了。”
“哈哈~旧神保佑，神父。”
嘴里轻松说着这些的艾什调转马头，和泽瑞尔闲聊，等着他骑上马后，与早就想离开的卡森并排在一起，三人已没了再帮助高精灵的任何念头。
跪地独自为自己弟弟哀悼的伊妮丝，不做出任何的指挥，和被冻硬尸体较劲的高精灵城防卫队士兵，以及那些畏缩，甚至可以说猥琐的高精灵神职，这样的画面，谁都不想再看一眼。
三人也没有和伊妮丝说离开，直接一起往回走，好在卡森照顾了三匹马，它们还不算太累，回去也能快很多，毕竟没人再拖慢行进的速度了。
回去的路上很顺利，而且卡森考虑到泽瑞尔的心情，有意避开被丢在路上的运物人尸体，换了条路跑起来，在下午返回了洛瑞安。
在城外脱掉甲胄，卸下武器，回到了旅馆，艾什把烤栗子丢给卡森照顾，自己摩拳擦掌，她肯定是要揍一顿巴尼那混蛋来解气的。

结果巴尼在他的房间里被嘶嘶的蛇尾紧紧缠绕，求着艾什让嘶嘶放开他，都因为艾什要嘶嘶看住巴尼那句话，小家伙理解成了绑住巴尼，缠了他一整天，连撒尿都没让他去。
艾什摇摇头，抱起嘶嘶，这孩子上半身轻，下半身的蛇尾沉的要命，基本上半抱半拖的带嘶嘶离开巴尼房间，嘶嘶还在艾什肩膀上对巴尼吐舌头做鬼脸，留下被压得直大喘气的巴尼无语。
“巴尼，你自己去问卡森我们几个经历了什么吧！我是要洗澡之后吃晚餐，享受我的床了！”
留下一句话给巴尼，艾什放下嘶嘶叫着好女孩去给姐姐准备洗澡水，转身给巴尼再竖起无名指嘲讽，艾什这才没了脾气，回到自己房间去换衣服休息。
剩下的事就很轻松了，艾什在房间里的浴桶内洗澡，嘶嘶在她身边去玩洗澡水，门外巴尼房间那边传来巴尼的痛呼，以及芙涅娅气愤的叫嚷。
这次巴尼给几人弄到的委托实在是太烂了，而且为了利益忽略了危险，这也是芙涅娅生气的地方，芙涅娅肯定不会向艾什那样懒得揍巴尼了。
听听巴尼的叫声吧，悲惨中还带着窃笑，他可知道被芙涅娅揍总要好过吃艾什的拳头。
舒舒服服的享受温暖的洗澡水，艾什擦拭掉身上沾染的血迹，回来路上她就用雪把脸上的血污擦了擦，以免回到洛瑞安时又被守门的士兵找麻烦。
辛苦了一夜，艾什不禁眯眼微笑，旅行中最快乐的事，就是吃到美食，喝到气泡水，睡在床上，有热水洗澡，至于其他的东西，艾什还没有更多的考虑。
嘶嘶的小手一会儿就不老实了，在艾什的身上摸摸戳戳，每次她都会惊讶于艾什胸前的伟大，然后把玩好久，艾什也懒得去管。
吃了灵魂的她还感受不到困，泽瑞尔也早早睡去，他没有艾什急切于洗澡的想法，可能心情还是不好，但是卡森不洗澡是不可能了，芙涅娅不会让他带着血腥味上床的。
洗好澡，换好衣服，沾了血的衣服留给嘶嘶明天洗，艾什就带着嘶嘶去旅馆一层向老板点了些肉食和甜点，嘶嘶还捧着几瓶她做的皮泡水跟着想吃，放在以前艾什绝对会呲牙，现在嘛，平淡了许多。
吃着精灵们一如既往发淡的烤香肠，艾什皱眉去向他们要胡椒和盐，这举动一定会让厨子不开心，艾什才不在乎他心里怎么想的，她吃的开心就好。
今晚很安静，整个旅馆一层就只有艾什和嘶嘶，旅馆老板一家人已经在做睡前的准备了，难得的清静，艾什也不急着吃东西，小口小口去享受忙碌许久后的肉食。
嘶嘶坐在艾什身边捧着束灵之书看绘本，嘴里还叼着半根鸡翅，束灵之书对谁都很刻薄，之前对嘶嘶也是，现在倒是蛮愿意嘶嘶拿着它看小孩子喜欢的东西。
艾什觉得不是束灵之书宠爱嘶嘶，只是因为嘶嘶在看绘本，让束灵之书认为它被需要，这家伙有时候想法多的吓人，尤其是艾什发懒，不愿意看束灵之书内的学识的时候，束灵之书就会生气地用书脊砸艾什的头。
安静的一夜，令人心情舒畅，尤其是博里克自己住在旅馆较远的房间，他的呼噜声吵不到艾什，外加上卡森忙碌一天也没了力气和芙涅娅寻开心，巴尼那混蛋也没在夜里唱歌，艾什能睡个好觉。
吃饱喝足回去睡觉的艾什，一直睡到了第二天的中午，她被嘶嘶的蛇尾摩擦声吵醒，小家伙也跟着睡了很久，流着口水蜷缩成一团，有时候艾什都怀疑她能把自己勒死。
旅馆内已经很热闹了，艾什在二楼房间里都能听到巴尼的琴声从一楼传来，这家伙买了不少乐器，鲁特琴、班卓琴、竖笛和小喇叭，自从他知道束灵之书里有乐谱后，就一直谄媚地求束灵之书给他看。
content_en:
Zerrell really couldn't stand the arrogance of the high elf priests towards the dead soldiers everywhere. Those bastards huddled together to keep warm, complaining about the slow movement of the city defense soldiers, muttering that the trip was dangerous and cold, and they just didn't conduct the prayer ceremony as soon as possible.
For Zerrell, who was also a priest, this was arrogant, rude and extremely blasphemous to the dead. Ash had advised him not to help the high elves, which would make Zerrell even more sad. However, full of pity and kindness, he still thanked Ash for his reminder and took the initiative to find Inis.
He still wanted to pray for the dead soldiers. He walked over and talked to Inis. After a few words, Zerrell walked back dejectedly. Without thinking too much, Ash could guess what Inis and Zerrell said.
Seeing Zerrell walking back and sighing with his hands on his hips, Ash grinned in amusement and played with his hair, raising his eyebrows as if he had known this would happen.
"Did she say that you are not an elf and do not need you to pray for the high elf soldiers?"
"Yes..."
"Did she also say, thank you for your kindness, but there are other priests here, and you don't understand their traditions and customs?"
"That's right..."
"Finally, let me tell you that our commission has ended. How many of us can leave now?"
"Alas..."
This sigh already proved that Ash's guesses were correct. She sneered in a strange tone, patted the snowflakes on her body and on the star's iron skirt, and whistled at the roasted chestnut not far away. The roasted chestnut ran over unhurriedly with its hooves buried, and touched Ash's face with its nose.
Ash rubbed Roasted Chestnut's horse's head, turned his face and flicked his tongue at Zariel, who was frustrated and didn't understand Inis's thoughts. When the other person raised his head with a sad face, she got on the horse and stepped on the stirrups firmly and sneered.
"I no longer trust these high elves. Father, let's go. Let's go back and let them figure out their own solutions to their bad things. Since they don't accept the kindness of an excellent priest like you, it's because they are stupid. We can still have dinner when we go back now."
"Well...I still feel like I'm not as...excellent as you said, but you're right, Ash, I want to rest."
"Haha~Old gods bless you, Father."
Ash, who was saying this easily, turned his horse's head, chatted with Zerrell, and waited for him to get on the horse. Then he stood side by side with Carson, who had long wanted to leave. The three of them had no more thoughts of helping the high elf.
Inis was kneeling on her knees mourning her brother alone, not giving any orders, the High Elf City Defense soldiers fighting against the frozen corpse, and the cowering, even wretched High Elf priests. No one wanted to look at this scene again.
The three of them didn't tell Inis to leave, and just walked back together. Fortunately, Carson took care of the three horses. They were not too tired, and they could go back much faster. After all, no one was slowing down the progress anymore.
The journey back went smoothly, and Carson, considering Zerrell's mood, deliberately avoided the corpse of the carrier dumped on the road, changed the route and ran, returning to Lorien in the afternoon.
After taking off her armor and weapons outside the city, and returning to the hotel, Ash left the roasted chestnuts to Carson to take care of, and she was ready to fight. She was definitely going to beat that bastard Barney to relieve her anger.
As a result, Barney was tightly wrapped around hissing snake tail in his room, begging Ash to let hissing let him go, all because Ash wanted hissing to look at Barney's words. The little guy understood it as tying up Barney and pestering him all day long, not even letting him go to pee.
Ash shook his head and picked up Hiss. The child's upper body was light but his lower body was extremely heavy. He basically half-carried and half-dragged Hiss out of Barney's room. Hiss was still sticking out his tongue and making faces at Barney on Ash's shoulder, leaving Barney speechless and gasping for air.
"Barney, go ask Carson how we areWhat have you been through! I'm going to take a shower, have dinner, and enjoy my bed! "
Leaving a message for Barney, Ash put down his hissing "Good Girl" and went to prepare bath water for his sister. He turned around and raised his ring finger to Barney to taunt again. Ash lost his temper and returned to his room to change clothes and rest.
The rest was easy. Ash took a bath in the tub in the room and Hissed beside her to play with the bath water. Barney's screams of pain and Funea's angry shouts could be heard from Barney's room outside the door.
The commission that Barney got for several people this time was really bad, and he ignored the danger for the sake of profit. This is what makes Funea angry. Funea will definitely not be as lazy as Ash to beat Barney.
Listen to Barney's cry, snickering in misery. He knows that being punched by Funea is better than being punched by Ash.
Enjoying the warm bath water comfortably, Ash wiped off the blood on her body. On the way back, she wiped the blood on her face with snow to avoid being troubled by the soldiers guarding the gate again when she returned to Lorien.
After a hard night, Ash couldn't help but squint and smile. The happiest things during the trip were eating delicious food, drinking sparkling water, sleeping on the bed, and having hot water to take a shower. As for other things, Ash had not thought more about it.
Hissing little hands soon became disloyal, stroking and prodding Ash's body. Every time she was surprised by the greatness of Ash's chest, and then played with it for a long time, and Ash was too lazy to care.
She couldn't feel sleepy after eating the soul, and Zerrell also went to bed early. He was not as anxious as Ash to take a bath, and he might still be in a bad mood, but it was impossible for Carson not to take a bath, and Funea would not let him go to bed with the smell of blood.
After taking a shower and changing clothes, leaving the blood-stained clothes for Xisi to wash tomorrow, Ash took Xisi to the first floor of the hotel and ordered some meat and desserts from the boss. Hissi also held a few bottles of skin soaking water she made and wanted to eat them. In the past, Ash would definitely grit his teeth, but now, it's much calmer.
Eating the elves' grilled sausages that were bland as always, Ash frowned and asked them for pepper and salt. This move would definitely make the cook unhappy. Ash didn't care what he thought, as long as she was happy eating.
It was very quiet tonight. There were only Ash and Hiss on the entire first floor of the hotel. The hotel owner and his family were already making preparations before going to bed. In the rare quiet time, Ash was not in a hurry to eat and just took small bites to enjoy the meat after being busy for a long time.
Hiss sat next to Ash, holding the Book of Souls and reading a picture book, with half a chicken wing in his mouth. The Book of Souls was very mean to everyone, and it was also towards Hiss before, but now Hess is quite willing to use it to read things that children like.
Ash felt that it wasn't the Book of Souls that doted on Hiss, but that Hiss was reading picture books, which made the Book of Souls think it was needed. This guy sometimes had scary ideas, especially when Ash was lazy and unwilling to read the knowledge in the Book of Souls, the Book of Souls would angrily hit Ash on the head with the spine of the book.
A quiet night made people feel comfortable, especially since Borrick himself lived in a far away room in the hotel, and his snoring could not disturb Ash. In addition, Carson had a busy day and had no energy to have fun with Funya, and that bastard Barney didn't sing at night, so Ash could have a good sleep.
After eating and drinking, Ash went back to sleep. She slept until noon the next day. She was awakened by the hissing sound of the snake's tail rubbing together. The little one also slept for a long time, drooling and curled up in a ball. Sometimes Ash even suspected that she could strangle herself to death.
The hotel was already very lively, and Ash could hear Barney's music coming from the first floor even in his room on the second floor. This guy bought a lot of musical instruments, including lutes, banjos, recorders, and trumpets. Ever since he knew that there were music scores in the Book of Souls, he had been flatteringly begging the Book of Souls to show him.
